label: Problem Set 1
title: The geometry of events
description: Set notation, complements, De Morgan’s laws, Venn diagrams, and inclusion–exclusion. No probability background assumed.

label: Problem Set 2
title: Counting, events, and shared birthdays
description: Probability spaces, permutations, combinations, binomial identities, inclusion–exclusion, and the birthday paradox.

label: Problem Set 3
title: Counting, collisions, and derangements
description: Discrete probability spaces, poker and word counts, birthday bounds, collision patterns, and the hat-check problem.

label: Problem Set 4
title: Distributions, tails, and coupon collection
description: Discrete and continuous laws, coupon completion deadlines, signed tail areas, a capped carnival prize, and a highest-bid pizza auction.
details: 8 core problems + challenge · 100 points · About 4 hours

label: Class quiz
title: Conditional probability and Bayes’ rule
description: Finite probability spaces, conditioning from a table, total probability, and a guided solution to Monty Hall.

label: Class quiz
title: Birthdays, derangements, and a little calculus
description: The series and approximations behind birthday collisions and derangements, followed by a Bayes’ rule problem.

label: Class quiz
title: Expectation, variance, and discrete distributions
description: Discrete probability spaces, moments, Bernoulli indicators, binomial counts, and geometric waiting times.

label: Class quiz
title: Discrete and continuous distributions
description: Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, exponential, and uniform distributions, with a guided coupon-collector problem.

label: Weekly quiz collection
title: Ten checkpoints from sets to inference
description: Short quizzes following the course from events and distributions through estimation and Bayesian inference, with writing space.
